search_services.description: Filter or count services by state, urban/rural classification, service type, or exact overall NQS rating. Use this for factual lookup/listing questions. Do NOT use it to rank regulatory risk; use find_high_risk_services for prioritisation.

get_service_profile.description: Return decision-relevant fields for one exact service approval number, including location, NQS rating, authorised capacity, and transport distances.

calculate_risk_score.description: Calculate the validated v1 three-gap risk assessment for one service approval number. Returns eligibility, the 0-3 gap score, component flags, thresholds, and limitations.

find_high_risk_services.description: Rank Centre-Based Care services for regulatory prioritisation using the deterministic v1 risk model. Use this when the user asks which services are highest risk, should be investigated first, or requests a priority/top-k list. If no top_k is specified, use 20. For the phrase highest-risk without another threshold, use minimum_gap_score=3 (triple-gap); use 2 for a broader high-risk candidate pool.

compare_transport_access.description: Compare aggregate public-transport access statistics across urban/rural groups, states, or service types, optionally filtered by state or service type.

analyse_transport_quartile_outcomes.description: Analyse NQS quality outcomes and authorised capacity across transport-access quartiles Q1-Q4. Use this for questions about whether poorer transport access is associated with quality or capacity patterns. It does not establish unmet demand or causality.

simulate_risk_thresholds.description: Run deterministic sensitivity analysis against the fixed v1 P75 transport / P25 capacity baseline. Use when the user asks what happens if a percentile threshold changes. Percentiles are decimals such as 0.80 for P80 and are always calculated from the national validated Centre-Based Care sample; state or rural/urban filters only scope the reported impact. Returns threshold values, priority-pool counts, changes, subgroup impacts, and services entering or leaving the pool. Do not calculate scenario counts yourself.

compare_risk_scenarios.description: Compare two arbitrary deterministic Centre-Based Care risk scenarios. Use when the user gives Scenario A versus Scenario B, broad versus strict settings, or asks which assumption set creates a larger/smaller priority pool. Threshold percentiles are always national; subgroup filters only scope impacts. Returns A/B counts, overlap, differences, subgroup impacts, and services unique to each scenario.

transport_percentile.description: National Centre-Based Care percentile as a decimal; 0.80 means P80.
transport_percentile.title: Transport Percentile

capacity_percentile.description: National Centre-Based Care percentile as a decimal; 0.20 means P20.
capacity_percentile.title: Capacity Percentile

minimum_gap_score.description: Minimum number of overlapping gaps required for the priority pool.
minimum_gap_score.title: Minimum Gap Score

search_policy.description: Retrieve grounded passages from the curated official ACECQA/NQF policy and guidance corpus. Use this for the meaning of NQS ratings, assessment/rating process, regulatory authority powers, monitoring, proportionality, compliance tools, NQF obligations, or policy-grounded recommendations. For a recommendation that combines service risk data with regulatory guidance, call the relevant analytics tool AND search_policy. Risk flags alone do not establish a legal breach.
